"""Coverage form for port_methods_without_use_case (G0 review finding 4): `get_draft` is
referenced from application/use_cases/runner.py.txt below, so it has a use. `publish` is
referenced only from infrastructure/mcp/tools/flow.py.txt, which sits under infrastructure/, not
application/use_cases/, so that reference must not count -- a port method's use is counted only
from modules under application/use_cases/."""

from __future__ import annotations

from abc import ABC, abstractmethod


class FlowPort(ABC):
    @abstractmethod
    def get_draft(self) -> None:
        """Compliant: application/use_cases/runner.py.txt calls this."""

    @abstractmethod
    def publish(self) -> None:
        """VIOLATION: port_methods_without_use_case -- the only reference to `.publish` sits in
        infrastructure/mcp/tools/flow.py.txt, outside application/use_cases/."""
